text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (—No good.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Now I'm completely lost.
Aaah, what am I gonna do—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What should I give to Trainer
for Valentine's Day~?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's a gift to thank them for always helping me out,
so I want it to be something they'll really love...
I wonder what'd be good?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no use just standing here thinking.
Anyway, I've gotta look around!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"A wonderful bite with a romantic aroma"...
I wonder if mature stuff like this is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Romantic, huh... I wonder if Trainer
is into that kind of thing—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Come... raise your head, my honey.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
For my darling, today...
I've got the most lovely present ready for ya.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"From here on out too... stay by my side forever, okay?
My beloved Honey..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, who the heck are youuu?!
Are you some kind of prince?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Things got weirdly romantic. Is it 'cause I watched that romance drama last week...?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, focus!
Alright, let's hit the next shop!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(This place feels more like it's aimed at students.
Oh my, there are heart shapes everywhere... So cute.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Is this student-like kind of thing okay too?
Like, if it's heart-shaped chocolates, maybe—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sooorryyyy!!
I was fixing my bangs and ended up running late...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "The reason I called you out today was... um... because there's something I wanted to tell you! That is—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: H-Happy Valentine's Day!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Please accept... my precious feelings!! Tee-hee☆

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Seriously, who is this supposed to be?!
A walking shojo manga heroine trope?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Aah, just imagining it makes my face burn...! She's way too different from me!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —"Collaboration product with a cooking show starring popular idols"...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Nah, even I can tell by now.
An idol style is definitely...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Gating-in straight to your heart☆
Delivering love feelings sweeter than chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, that's enough!
Just act normal for once!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(You're just expressing your daily gratitude, right?
In that case, without doing anything weird, just normally—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Just normal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, I'll do my best as Bokeh-no-Lilac!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, I'll do my best as the funny-woman Lilac!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Let's enjoy and blossom in today's Oka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Lawa mugi lawa gome, lawa hamago!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (............Wait, is it okay to just be normal?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm supposed to give this to that Trainer?
The guy who's usually an absolute airhead?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And they're doing all that... for my sake.
They're taking my gags dead seriously,
just so we can win races together.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(In that case... shouldn't I give it my all too?
Without shrinking back into being "ordinary", just for this once...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Alright. Time to show 'em what I've got!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Bow before the sight of this chocolate~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Valentine's. The moment Lucky Lilac entered
the room, she dropped a line straight out of a period drama!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Bow down, Lord Chocolate has arrived!
Come on, hold out yer hands!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding out my hand as told, a parcel is plunked
right into it. And right then, I realized—
choice_data_list: Ah... Is this for Valentine's, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I ran all over east and west to get this matcha chocolate!
I just hope it suits your taste!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's totally immersed in her period drama role...
but this seems to be a Valentine's gift.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: I, your unworthy Trainer, humbly accept!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...That is well!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, it's about time I set off.
Take care, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(That was SO embarrassing~~~!!
My heart was pounding so hard I thought it'd fly right out!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still... that went way better than expected.
Trainer got into it too...
and seemed to be havin' a good time.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Ah well, whatever! All right!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san.
They're handmade, but please take them if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Since we have it right here, please enjoy it now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the package, I saw a chocolate cookie.
It was fan-shaped with jagged edges,
just like a ginkgo leaf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lucky Lilac, straight-man retorts, folding fan.
Connecting all those dots, an idea flashed in my mind."
choice_data_list: Wait, is this shaped like a harisen paper fan?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No, it's a bubbly feather fan.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. From now on, I'm thinking
of going with a bubbly, 80s boom persona.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I've been practicing dancing too.
If you'd like, shall I dance for you right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why the bubble-era look? What's with that folding fan?
A million questions spring to mind, but right now there's only one thing to say—!
choice_data_list: No... like hell it is, seriously?!?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Heh... fufu!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I was waiting for that comeback.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for startling you.
Everything I just said was a joke, so don't worry.
choice_data_list: Thank goodness... you had me worried, wondering what suddenly came over you

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I was on pins and needles too.
Wonderin' what I'd do if nobody called me out."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still... even if it's something I don't normally do,
I've decided to give it my absolute all."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It is Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "You were always doing all this for me, weren't you? Giving it your absolute all, just for my sake."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Because you play the straight man's foil like that... I can play the straight man with everything I've got. And run as far as I want.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"That makes me very happy.
—Thank you, as always."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Would you like to share some cookies?
Let's brew some tea and take our time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then... once again,
Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer.
